item.dc:creator: Graham Readfearn,Oliver Milman and Fiona Harvey in Antalya, Turkey

item.title: France accuses Iran of supermarket fridge hacking
item.description: France's Foreign Minister Jean-Noël Barrot says the Iran's Revolutionary Guards Corp is behind the "unprecedented" cyber attacks on supermarket fridges as he vows to press for Europe-wide sanctions. Publicado también por: ABC News Australia. Fuente: BBC News - World.

item.title: Pope draws record Buenos Aires crowd after rebuking Milei over austerity
item.description: More than 2.5 million worshippers attend the pontiff's Mass in the Argentinian capital, with some camping overnight to get a glimpse of the Catholic leader. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Mona Vale beachfront home fetches record $29 million
item.description: A Mona Vale beachfront house recently set a new record by selling for A$29 million in a private sale. The property was previously owned by McDonald's Australia's chief executive and sold for A$7.65 million in 2014. The sale was conducted discreetly without public marketing, ensuring privacy for the owners. The previous record for Mona Vale was A$13.5 million, established in October 2025. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
item.dc:creator: TOI Real Estate Desk

item.title: Amateur prospector finds 1.2-kg gold nugget worth A$150,000 in Australia
item.description: In a remarkable discovery, a hobbyist prospector unearthed a significant gold nugget weighing 1,218 grams in New South Wales. With approximately 940 grams of pure gold, its value is estimated between A$150,000 and A$200,000. The Tibooburra area continues to draw gold seekers and tourists, with this nugget serving as a testament to the dedication and perseverance required in the thrilling quest for gold. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: COP31 summit targets major electrification push as 1.5C goal slips away
item.description: The climate summit will push for nations around the world to electrify their energy faster and move away from fossil fuels, as Chris Bowen predicts global temperatures will rise to 2.6 degrees above pre-industrial levels. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Laura Tingle

item.title: Ancient underwater canyons reveal clues to the world's oldest animal life
item.description: Geologists have uncovered new evidence that dramatic sea-level changes carved giant underwater canyons in South Australia's Flinders Ranges hundreds of millions of years ago, helping to create conditions that preserved some of the earliest complex life on Earth. The findings, led by Adelaide University, shed new light on the environmental changes that accompanied the rise of the mysterious Ediacaran biota. Fuente: Phys.org.

item.title: Inicia COP31 Turquía- Australia con los combustibles fósiles y la energía en el centro del debate
item.description: La transición energética, los combustibles fósiles y la electrificación vuelven a ser temas centrales de la agenda de la COP31 en Turquía y copresidida por Australia. Entre otros temas que juegan un papel importante de los debates también se encuentra la guerra en Irán, que aumentó los precios globales del petróleo. Nuestro enviado especial, Adrià Rocha, se encuentra en la ciudad de Antalya, que ejerce como anfitrión oficial, mientras las negociaciones oficiales se realizarán en territorio australiano. Fuente: France 24 - Español.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE24

item.title: The sales tactics to be on alert for this Black Friday
item.description: Bogus "countdown timers", false "storewide" discount claims and misleading price comparisons are in the spotlight as the consumer watchdog cracks down this sales season. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Jessica Irvine

item.title: Ireland's Jansen ruled out of Fiji and Bok games
item.description: Sean Jansen is ruled out of the remainder of Ireland's Nations Championship campaign with a knee injury, further depleting head coach Andy Farrell's options at number eight. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: Gunman dies in hospital after killing six and injuring 15 in Krakow shooting
item.description: A gunman who killed six people and injured 15 others in a mass shooting in central Krakow, Poland, has died in hospital. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: WA Aboriginal affairs minister visits Pilbara amid child welfare crisis
item.description: Don Punch faces calls to resign as he visits South Hedland for the first time since reports emerged of children living in squalid conditions. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Kimberley Putland, Amy Rossbach, Alistair Bates, and Keane Bourke

item.title: Ukrainian drone attack sets Russia's Kirishi refinery ablaze
item.description: Russia's second-largest oil refinery has been set ablaze following a Ukrainian drone attack that killed a local woman, a day before Russian, Ukrainian and US negotiators sit down for their first peace talks since February. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Khawaja 100% accurate on ball-tampering - Warner
item.description: David Warner says he throws his "full support" behind former team-mate Usman Khawaja following his claim that all the Australia players knew about ball-tampering. Publicado también por: ABC News Australia. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: Police charged over alleged e-bike hit and run in Sydney
item.description: NSW Police is reviewing the employment status of two constables, aged 27 and 25, following the alleged hit and run. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Fagan's understudy Bruce named Brisbane's new senior coach
item.description: Brisbane goes in-house to choose its successor to three-time premiership winning coach Chris Fagan, as Cameron Bruce wins the race for the prized job. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Jessica Stewart and Chris De Silva

item.title: Fuel retailer accused of selling unleaded 91 as premium petrol
item.description: The WA Commissioner for Consumer Protection launches civil court action against a fuel retailer it alleges has been making false or misleading claims about the octane rating of petrol. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Emma Wynne, Oliver Peterson, and Lucie Bell

item.title: Bouquet of invasive weeds wins agricultural show award
item.description: An arrangement of weeds that are infesting parts of WA's South West gets a couple of gongs that the winner hopes will help to highlight the issue of problem plants. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Georgia Loney

item.title: Cop31 live: world leaders gather for crucial climate crisis talks
item.description: UN climate summit will focus on how to implement the targets needed to urgently cut greenhouse gas emissions What is at stake at the UN climate summit and what can it achieve? Key players at the climate talks One of the most promising areas of potential progress is on electrification, which is needed to reduce global greenhouse gas emissions. Despite the strong growth in renewable energy around the world, nearly 80% of primary energy still comes from fossil fuels, used for transport, heating and industrial purposes. Adopting electric vehicles, heat pumps, batteries and other low-carbon… Fuente: The Guardian - Environment.
item.dc:creator: Ajit Niranjan

item.title: Breaking: Warner says Khawaja's ball-tampering claim '100 per cent accurate'
item.description: David Warner throws his full support behind his childhood friend, Usman Khawaja, while slamming Cricket Australia's investigation into ball tampering. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Chris De Silva

item.title: Premier says tougher laws 'will be considered' after war memorials damaged
item.description: Queensland premier David Crisafulli says tougher laws "will be considered" after two separate acts of vandalism on war memorials over the last 48 hours. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: NT teen 'keyboard warrior' charged with terrorism offences seeks bail
item.description: Lawyers for a Northern Territory teenager charged with terrorism offences last month say he is a "keyboard warrior" who should be "treated, not penalised", as a court considers his application for bail. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Roxanne Fitzgerald

item.title: Calls for data centre moratorium 'until we get the rules right'
item.description: The Conservation Council is calling for a moratorium on new data centre developments in the ACT until tougher rules are in place, amid "increasing concerns" about the impact on Canberra's water supply and electricity grid. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Penny Travers and Annabel Whitehouse

item.title: 'High-priority': Overseer of QLD demerits system implores government to act
item.description: After demerit points black markets are exposed by 7.30, the man who oversaw the introduction of Queensland's system in the 90s says the Crisafulli government must act. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Tom Hartley

item.title: England make massive step up in Australia victory
item.description: In his latest column, England World Cup winner Matt Dawson reflects on an impressive win for Steve Borthwick's side against Australia in the Nations Championship. Fuente: BBC Sport.
